title: Israel says ~400 Hezbollah fighters killed in Lebanon since ceasefire began
detail: Israel says some 400 Hezbollah fighters have been killed in Lebanon since the ceasefire began. The figure is an Israeli claim reported via an aggregated news feed and is not independently verified.

title: US steps up pressure on Hezbollah with new sanctions, including on a linked charity
detail: The United States announced new sanctions targeting Iran-backed Hezbollah, including a Hezbollah-linked charity, as Washington increases financial pressure on the group.
